sentences.en: Hello everyone.
sentences.zh: 大家好。

sentences.en: My name's Megan Baker and I'm a recruitment consultant at AVT Recruitment specialists.
sentences.zh: 我叫梅根·贝克，是AVT招聘专家公司的招聘顾问。

sentences.en: Now, our company specialises in positions that involve working in the agriculture and horticulture sectors, so that's fresh food production, garden and park maintenance and so on.
sentences.zh: 我们公司专门从事农业和园艺领域的工作岗位，例如新鲜食品生产、花园及公园维护等。

sentences.en: And these sectors do provide some very special career opportunities.
sentences.zh: 这些领域确实提供了一些非常特别的职业机会。

sentences.en: For a start, they often offer opportunities for those who don't want to be stuck with a 40-hour week, but need to juggle work with other responsibilities such as child care- and this is very important for many of our recruits.
sentences.zh: 首先，它们常常为那些不想被固定在每周40小时工作制中、但又需要兼顾其他责任（例如育儿）的人提供机会——这对我们的许多应聘者而言非常重要。

sentences.en: Some people like working in a rural setting, surrounded by plants and trees instead of buildings, although we can't guarantee that.
sentences.zh: 有些人喜欢在乡村环境中工作，周围环绕着植物和树木，而非高楼大厦，尽管我们无法对此作出保证。

sentences.en: But there are certainly health benefits, / especially in jobs where you're not sitting all day looking at a screen- a big plus for many people.
sentences.zh: 但这类工作无疑具有健康益处，尤其是那些无需整天坐在屏幕前的工作——这对许多人来说是一个很大的优势。

sentences.en: Salaries can sometimes be good too, although there's a lot of variety here.
sentences.zh: 薪资有时也很可观，不过这方面差异较大。

sentences.en: And you may have the opportunity in some types of jobs for travel overseas, although that obviously depends on the job, and not everyone is keen to do it.
sentences.zh: 在某些类型的工作中，你还有可能获得海外出差的机会，但这显然取决于具体职位，并非所有人都愿意这么做。

sentences.en: Of course, working outdoors does have its challenges.
sentences.zh: 当然，在户外工作也存在一些挑战。

sentences.en: It's fine in summer, but can be extremely unpleasant when it's cold and windy.
sentences.zh: 夏天工作很舒适，但寒冷多风的天气下则可能极为不适。

sentences.en: You may need to be pretty fit for some jobs, though with modern technology that's not as important as it once was.
sentences.zh: 某些岗位可能要求你具备相当强的体能，不过随着现代技术的发展，这一点已不如过去那么重要。

sentences.en: And standards of health and safety are much higher now than they used to be, so there are fewer work-related accidents.
sentences.zh: 如今的健康与安全标准远高于以往，因此与工作相关的事故已大幅减少。

sentences.en: But if you like a lively city environment surrounded bv lots of people, these jobs are probably not for you- they're often in pretty remote areas.
sentences.zh: 如果你喜欢热闹的城市环境，周围人群熙攘，那么这些工作很可能并不适合你——它们通常位于相当偏远的地区。

sentences.en: And some people worry about finding a suitable place to live, but in our experience, this usually turns out fine.
sentences.zh: 有些人担心难以找到合适的住所，但根据我们的经验，这通常都能顺利解决。

sentences.en: / / / Now let me tell you about some of the exciting jobs that we have on our books right now.
sentences.zh: 接下来，让我为大家介绍一些目前我们职位库中令人兴奋的岗位。

sentences.en: One is for a fresh food commercial manager.
sentences.zh: 其中一个岗位是新鲜食品商业经理。

sentences.en: Our client here is a very large fresh food producer supplying a range of top supermarkets.
sentences.zh: 我们的客户是一家大型新鲜食品生产商，为多家顶级超市供货。

sentences.en: They operate in a very fast-paced environment with low profit margins- the staff there work hard, but they play hard as well, so if you've a sociable personality this may be for you.
sentences.zh: 他们运营于节奏极快、利润率较低的环境中——那里的员工工作努力，业余生活也同样丰富多彩；因此，如果你性格外向、善于交际，这个职位可能正适合你。

sentences.en: We have an exciting post as an agronomist advising farmers on issues such as crop nutrition, protection against pests, and the latest legislation on farming and agricultural practices.
sentences.zh: 我们还有一个极具吸引力的农艺师职位，负责就作物营养、病虫害防治以及最新农业与耕作相关法规等问题向农民提供建议。

sentences.en: There are good opportunities for the right person to quickly make their wav up the career ladder, but a deep knowledge of the agricultural sector is expected of applicants.
sentences.zh: 对于合适的人选而言，职业晋升前景广阔，但申请人须对农业领域具备深厚的专业知识。

sentences.en: A leading supermarket is looking for a fresh produce buyer who is available for a 12-month maternity cover contract.
sentences.zh: 一家领先的超市正在招聘新鲜农产品采购员，合同期为12个月，用于填补产假空缺。

sentences.en: You need to have experience in administration, planning and buying in the fresh produce industry, and in return will receive a very competitive salary.
sentences.zh: 你需要具备新鲜农产品行业中的行政管理、计划制定及采购经验，作为回报，你将获得极具竞争力的薪资。

sentences.en: Audioscripts We have also received a request for a sales manager for a chain of garden centres.
sentences.zh: 我们还收到一家连锁园艺中心招聘销售经理的需求。

sentences.en: You will be visiting centres in the region to ensure their high levels of customer service are maintained.
sentences.zh: 你将需定期走访本地区的各园艺中心，以确保其维持高水平的客户服务。

sentences.en: This post is only suitable for someone who is prepared to live in the region.
sentences.zh: 该职位仅适合愿意在本地区定居的人士。

sentences.en: There is also a vacancy for a tree technician to carry out tree cutting, forestry and conservation work.
sentences.zh: 此外，还有一个树艺技师的空缺职位，负责树木修剪、林业及生态保护等工作。

sentences.en: Candidates must have a clean driving licence and have training in safety procedures.
sentences.zh: 应聘者必须持有有效的驾驶执照，并接受过安全操作规程培训。

sentences.en: A year's experience would be preferred but the company might be prepared to consider someone who has just completed an appropriate training course.
sentences.zh: 一年相关工作经验为优先条件，但公司也可能考虑刚完成相关培训课程的候选人。

sentences.en: Finally, we have a position for a farm worker.
sentences.zh: 最后，我们还有一个农场工人职位。

sentences.en: This will involve a wide range of farm duties including crop sowing and harvesting, machine maintenance and animal care.
sentences.zh: 该职位涉及广泛的农场工作，包括作物播种与收获、农机维护以及动物护理。

sentences.en: Perks of the job include the possibility of renting a small cottage on the estate, and the chance to earn a competitive salary.
sentences.zh: 该工作的福利包括有机会租住庄园内的一间小屋，并可获得具有竞争力的薪资。

sentences.en: A driving licence and tractor driving experience are essential.
sentences.zh: 持有驾驶执照及具备拖拉机驾驶经验为必备条件。
